lines: Good morning. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Alberta Premier Smith says U.S. midterm results ‘vindicate’ her approach to tariffs, The Canadian Press reports.
Finance Minister François-Philippe Champagne says Thursday’s federal budget is about giving Canada a “strong footing” to navigate a more volatile world, The Canadian Press reports.
First Nations Bank of Canada has announced a $15-million investment by the Mississaugas of the Credit First Nation, The Canadian Press reports.

Voters delivered a sweeping rebuke of President Trump and his party in the midterms, handing Democrats major victories and dramatically reshaping the balance of power in Washington, PBS NewsHour reports.
Wong, 30, has been imprisoned since 2020 and is the only activist in Hong Kong prosecuted twice under national security laws, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
